newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials lower in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials lower in early trading.

text.p: The Dow Industrials fell prey to profit-taking at the open on Wednesday after a rally took the index to a new record close on Tuesday.
The Dow Industrials fell 11 point to 6,752 at the open. The Nasdaq Composite rose one to 1,347, while the S&P Index was off one at 768.
The 30-year treasury bond was off 11/32 to yield 6.80 percent as Wall Street opened.
